image.name: UGE International Inc.
image.subsector: Distributed and community solar and storage
image.description: UGE International Inc. is a New York-based distributed-energy platform that develops, builds, finances, owns and operates community and commercial solar and battery-storage projects in the United States. NOVA Infrastructure completed the take-private of predecessor UGE International Ltd. on August 15, 2024 through NOVA-Swift Holdco, LP; the business subsequently continued to Delaware as UGE International Inc. NOVA continues to identify UGE as a Fund II platform, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was found through September 1, 2026. Project SPVs, tax-equity vehicles, lenders and acquired development rights remain beneath the single platform boundary.

image.name: I-595 Express, LLC
image.description: I-595 Express, LLC is the concessionaire for the approximately 10.5-mile I-595 managed-lane corridor in Broward County, Florida. The company financed, designed and built the improvements and operates and maintains the corridor under a 35-year availability-payment DBFOM agreement with the Florida Department of Transportation. TIAA/Nuveen owns 87.5% through I 595 Toll Road, LLC and the TIAA General Account, while ACS/Iridium retains 12.5%. No later equity transfer or signed pending sale was identified through September 1, 2026. FDOT, the roadway and managed lanes, contractors, operators, lenders, noteholders and financing SPVs are counterparties or components rather than separate PortCos.

image.name: Bruce Power
image.description: Bruce Power operates eight CANDU nuclear generating units at the leased Bruce site in Ontario and supplies roughly 30% of the province's electricity together with medical isotopes. OMERS and TC Energy each own 48.26%, Power Workers' Union owns 2.22%, and Society, employee-trust and general-partner interests aggregate 1.26%. OMERS entered at the February 14, 2003 close through BPC Generation Infrastructure Trust. No later equity transfer or signed pending sale was identified through September 1, 2026. Ontario Power Generation owns and leases the site and is not a Bruce Power equity owner; station units, refurbishment programs, isotope ventures, contracts and financing entities remain beneath the single platform boundary.

image.name: Teranet Inc.
image.subsector: Land registry and statutory services concession
image.description: Teranet Inc. is a Canadian statutory-registry and digital public-service infrastructure platform. It operates Ontario's electronic land-search and registration system and Manitoba's land titles and personal-property registries under long-term contractual arrangements, serving governments, legal professionals, lenders, utilities, businesses and citizens. Teranet reports more than 850 employees, over 10 million annual transactions and more than 200 million registry images. OMERS Infrastructure acquired control in 2008 through a Borealis acquisition vehicle and owns 100% through Teranet Holdings LP. Earlier ownership comprised the Government of Ontario and Teramira consortium, followed by Teranet Income Fund's public structure. Registry data remains government-owned and regulated; operating subsidiaries and acquired service businesses are not separate PortCos. No later sale, exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

image.name: Skyway Concession Company LLC
image.description: Skyway Concession Company LLC is the concessionaire and operator of the Chicago Skyway, a 7.8-mile, six-lane toll road linking Chicago's Dan Ryan Expressway with the Indiana Toll Road. The company operates, maintains and tolls the facility under a 99-year concession that began on January 26, 2005 and runs to January 2104. Atlas Arteria owns 66.67% after acquiring the former CPP Investments and OMERS interests on December 1, 2022; Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan retains 33.33% from the 2016 pension-consortium acquisition. The City of Chicago and the roadway are not separate PortCos, and upstream holding entities are ownership vehicles. No signed pending sale or later ownership change was identified through August 19, 2026.

image.name: Intersect Power
image.subsector: Co-located power and data-center infrastructure development
image.description: Intersect Power is a U.S. digital-power infrastructure platform that develops co-located land, data-center shells, solar generation, battery storage and hybrid firming solutions for hyperscale cloud, AI and other energy-intensive customers. Google acquired the company on March 10, 2026 for US$4.75 billion, after making a minority investment in December 2024. The acquired company includes the Intersect team, digital-power business and specified co-located projects. Separate grid-tied operating and development assets were carved out into IPX Power and are not part of this PortCo. Former Intersect investors included Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, Greenbelt/Trilantic, TPG Rise Climate and Pantheon Infrastructure. Intersect reports a historical track record exceeding US$20 billion and 11.5 GW across 14 facilities, including legacy assets now assigned to IPX. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

image.name: Budderfly
image.subsector: Distributed energy-as-a-service and virtual power plants
image.description: Budderfly, Inc. is a U.S. energy-as-a-service platform that finances, installs, owns, monitors and maintains energy-efficiency and distributed-energy equipment under long-term customer contracts. Its solutions include HVAC, lighting, refrigeration, controls, solar, battery storage and virtual-power-plant capabilities for restaurants, retail, fitness, healthcare, hospitality, schools and manufacturing customers. Budderfly reports more than 8,500 customer locations nationwide, over US$248 million invested and average annual energy savings of approximately 22%. Partners Group completed a majority acquisition through Encore Holdings LP in July 2022 and committed more than US$500 million of growth capital; company management retained minority rollover equity. Edison Partners and Balance Point Capital are recorded as former investors. EnergyCloud is a product, Encore is the holding layer, and individual sites and acquired assets are not separate PortCos. No later sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
